Builder: Grok-3 (Matthew's PC, D:\Git\grok3).
Goal: each line of `wf board` (no page) shows the page's holder, the current step, and the next step, using the same data the page board already shows. Band door: 90.50.10.0400.
Lab: 90.50.10.0701 (wf loop lab). The lab trial is tests/lab_0424.rs, written by another view after this return. This page's own test file is tests/page_0424.rs.
Why: t541u G5, "wf board with holder, step and next" (docs/review/DIRECTOR-WORDS-t541-mvp-gaps.md). Needed before the 0498 MVP run. The grant is src/board.rs and tests/page_0424.rs only. Help text in src/lib.rs is out of grant and is left as it is.
Done when: cargo test --lib passes, and cargo test --test page_0424 passes on the box.
Done when: each readable book-board line still starts with two spaces, the page address, two spaces, the title, two spaces, and "entries N", so the tests/wf.rs book-board checks still pass, including "  10.10.10.0401  t  entries 4". tests/wf.rs is not in the grant and must not be edited.
Done when: each readable book-board line also shows holder, step, and next, for the highest-numbered pass whose tail is not closed, using the same data the page board already shows at src/board.rs:272 (the claim field, the pass tail, and pass_next). When that pass has no claim, or when the page has no such pass, holder is the word none. When the page has no such pass, step is the word none, and next is "Prime writes a 06 note, then wf draft <page>". If the page is halted, next is the same halt sentence status already uses. Unreadable lines are unchanged.

His words, t541u G5 (docs/review/DIRECTOR-WORDS-t541-mvp-gaps.md):

wf board with holder, step and next

What this page is: each line of the book-level board (`wf board` with no page) shows that page's holder, current step, and next step. It reuses the data the page board already shows at src/board.rs:272: the claim field, the pass tail, and pass_next.

What it does not do: it does not change column names. WF-BOARD Q1 (column names) stays open for Matthew. Prima's default, already in src/board.rs, is used: tool words are the columns, body-shop words are side labels only. It does not add a session lockout holder (that is 0423). It does not edit src/lib.rs. Help text stays as it is.

How the three fields are chosen:
- The current pass is the highest-numbered pass whose tail is not "closed", the same rule status already uses.
- Holder is that pass's claim, or the word none when the claim is empty or there is no such pass. This is the same field short_card prints at src/board.rs:272. After a return, the claim may still name the builder; do not invent a new "between steps, nobody holds it" rule here.
- Step is that pass's tail (the same word the page board prints at src/board.rs:271), or the word none when there is no such pass.
- Next is pass_next for that pass. When there is no such pass, next is "Prime writes a 06 note, then wf draft <page>". If the page is halted, next is the halt sentence already used by status (how_to_resume is already imported into board.rs). Copy those two sentences into board.rs; do not edit status.rs.

Keep the prefix "  {addr}  {title}  entries {n}" unchanged. {h} is the current pass's claim, escaped the same way as src/board.rs:272, or the word none when the claim is empty or there is no current pass. {s} is that pass's tail, or the word none when there is no current pass. {next} is pass_next for that pass; when there is no current pass it is "Prime writes a 06 note, then wf draft {addr}"; when the page is halted it is the existing halt sentence (halted. plus how_to_resume). The current pass is the highest-numbered pass whose tail is not "closed". Do not change COLUMNS or any page-board output. Do not edit src/lib.rs, src/status.rs, or tests/wf.rs. Unreadable lines are unchanged.
fields.w02: Add tests/page_0424.rs. It must build on Windows: no std::os::unix, and no check command that is only true, grep, or test (stage plan 11.7). Use the common test Env. Cover at least: a ready page with no pass (Env::ready) shows holder none, step none, next containing "wf draft", and the line still contains "  10.10.10.0401  t  entries 4"; after pack and before claim, holder is none, step is pack, and next contains "wf claim"; after claim (Env::open), holder is bob, step is open, and next contains "wf return"; after a return, holder is still bob (the claim field, same data as board.rs:272), step is return, and next contains "wf check"; after close, holder is none, step is none, and next contains "wf draft"; an unreadable page line is unchanged (same words as today's "unreadable: no log.jsonl" or "unreadable: log line 1 is not JSON"). The board still writes nothing. Do not copy the harness.
